title: The Chosen Emptiness

features.name: the clearing's mercy
features.desc-on-touch: You stand in what was cleared and chose to stay empty. Absence holds its own shape here.

features.name: the marker left
features.desc-on-touch: A single stone. The archive marks what it chose not to restore.

features.name: the breath of regrowth
features.desc-on-touch: The edge where plants have almost decided to return, then stopped, respecting the emptiness.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the paddock before the cut
narr: She stops at the fence line where the farmer decided
not to clear. The grass there is tall, unharvested, full
of small things that know no other home. Her hand rests
on the post. 'Some mercy is just leaving room,' she says.
You watch the space she means—not empty, but chosen
alive. The archive learns its first refusal from standing.

inscription: what is chosen empty stays honest

file.name: Unperformed_Mercy_Ledger.txt
file.note: A country doctor's field notes: procedures left undone, wounds tended by time instead of hands.

exits.label: back up the margin where silence gathers
down into the paddock growing over what's been left
east to where empty fields repeat
